Response.title: Rooms Keys List — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/keys/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/keys/list/0.1#response. The rooms this key holder can open, which is a different set from the rooms its principal is a member of: membership is a credential the room issued, and this is key custody. A room whose group state was never delivered is absent here and the principal may still hold a perfectly good VMC for it.

rooms.description: One entry per room, in no guaranteed order.

epoch.description: The epoch this key holder is at. Behind the room's own epoch means a commit has not been delivered, and records sealed since will not open.

earliestReadableEpoch.description: The earliest epoch this key holder can derive a key for, walking the epoch key chain it holds. Equal to `epoch` means it reads only from where it joined; `1` means the room's whole retained history. Anything between is a chain that has been delivered in part, or one deliberately severed below that point.
